title: HackerRank: Compare the Triplets
description: Alice and Bob each created one problem for HackerRank. A reviewer rates the two challenges, awarding points on a scale from 1 to 100 for three categories: problem clarity, originality, and difficulty. Given triplets `a` and `b`, return a list `[alice_pts, bob_pts]` comparing respective elements.
constraints:
len(a) == len(b) == 3
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def compare_triplets(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def compare_triplets(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    alice = sum(1 for x, y in zip(a, b) if x > y)
    bob = sum(1 for x, y in zip(a, b) if y > x)
    return [alice, bob]
explanation: Element-wise comparison over pairs tallies points in O(1) time.
